Class MemberService

java.lang.Object
library.service.MemberService
public class MemberService extends Object
Service class for library member management: registration with auto-generated member IDs (MEM-001, MEM-002, ...), update, delete, lookup and search. All member validation lives here, not in the GUI.
Author:
Usman

    • registerMember

      public Member registerMember(String name, String phone, String email) throws LibraryException
      Registers a new member with an auto-generated ID.
      Parameters:
      name - the member's name (required)
      phone - the phone number (optional, but must be valid if given)
      email - the email address (required, valid and unique)
      Returns:
      the newly created member
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if validation fails or the email is already registered

    • updateMember

      public Member updateMember(String memberId, String name, String phone, String email) throws LibraryException
      Updates an existing member's details.
      Parameters:
      memberId - the ID of the member to update
      name - the new name
      phone - the new phone (optional)
      email - the new email (must stay unique)
      Returns:
      the updated member
      Throws:
      LibraryException - if the member does not exist or validation fails

    • deleteMember

      public Member deleteMember(String memberId) throws LibraryException

      Throws:
